title: A service card: creation, types and reuse
goal: Save and reread a service, inspect its metadata types and reuse the same item in separate requests.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 4; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: Code differs from name
paragraphs: A code supports agreed lookup/exchange rules; a name serves people; a reference supplies internal identity. Services can have similar names, so check code and meaning before adding one. Do not create a duplicate merely because a text search missed a row hidden by a filter.

Inspect Услуги in Designer, including standard Код/Наименование and any custom attributes, then open the actual service card in Enterprise. Metadata defines available fields; the card contains one item’s values. Use actual field names and types rather than placing a price in the name to imitate a missing attribute.

sections.title: Reuse one item
paragraphs: Separate the work description from individual requests.

code.source:
Service S2: Диагностика A5 — выезд
R3 → S2: 20 minutes
R4 → S2: 40 minutes
code.output: Both documents reference the same service code; durations belong to the requests.

sections.title: Rates can change over time
paragraphs: A current rate in a card suffices for the initial model but does not describe price history. If an old request must preserve the agreed cost, store its applied rate in the document. P6 introduces periodic prices. Do not silently recalculate old documents from today’s card without a separate business rule.

Create Диагностика A5 — выезд and record its code. Select it in two own requests of 20 and 40 minutes. Creating another request must not require another service item. After renaming the service, both links should still open the same code. A customer code and a service code belong to different catalogs.

sections.title: Duplicates need a criterion
paragraphs: The teaching set uses unique service codes. Repeating the seed must find existing items rather than insert duplicates. A name lookup alone is not a uniqueness policy. Stop and explain ambiguous matches. Automatically deleting one similar-looking item can destroy document references.

A service name or description does not establish its price on a request date. Historical tariffs need a separate model, such as the periodic register introduced in the programming course. This exercise covers catalog reuse, not currency, payroll or statutory accounting.

sections.title: A price in the name is not tariff history
paragraphs: Historical tariffs need their own model and effective date.

code.output: The current text changed; no dated price was created for an older request.

sections.title: Verify repeatability
paragraphs: Create Consultation andSetup with codesS1, S2, then repeat the same-code input. Compare counts and references, not only labels. RenameS1 in a copy and reopen a linked request. Keep source and test copy distinct so rate experiments do not alter earlier work.

Specify the minimal scenario before changing metadata. An optional text description can follow module 4 in a separate copy: define its type/length, add the attribute and check older items. Changing an existing populated field’s type needs data analysis and recovery planning. The core exercise inspects existing types and saves your own service.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: A request duration is placed in the service name. Keep minutes in the document and select a reusable service card.
Equal codes in different catalogs are treated as one identity. Compare object kind and code together and open the correct card.
Renaming is treated as historical pricing. Model the tariff and effective period separately from the service presentation.

selfcheck.feedback: The kind of work exists independently of requests.
Current text does not preserve history.

selfcheck.prompt: Design an optional service description and explain the additional requirements of dated tariffs.
selfcheck.feedback: Type/length and older-item checks specified; names are not tariff history.

steps.title: Inspect the catalog
steps.action: Inspect properties, Data and standard attributes. Record Код/Наименование names/types and two custom fields if present. Rename nothing.
steps.troubleshooting: If custom attributes are absent, state that rather than invent them.
steps.before: Your module 4 work and copy provenance are retained; actual infobase path identified.

steps.title: Save your service
steps.action: Enter Диагностика A5 — выезд. Save, close and reopen by its actual code. Reuse your existing attempt if present.
steps.why: Test a real write and reread.
steps.troubleshooting: For truncated text, inspect the allowed length and retain the meaning within it.

steps.title: Select it in two requests
steps.action: Create own requests with an existing synthetic customer, this service, Новая and 20/40 minutes. Record numbers.
steps.why: Separate request duration from service identity.
steps.troubleshooting: Use the item picker instead of free text.

steps.title: Refine its name and verify links
steps.where: Enterprise → your service, then two requests
steps.action: Append — проверено, save and reopen both requests. Open the service from each and compare the code; durations stay 20/40.
steps.why: Test references after a display change.
steps.expected: Same service code and original durations.
steps.troubleshooting: Renaming a card does not require changing metadata field types.

steps.title: Record the result boundary
steps.action: Record actual codes/numbers, field types and the conclusion: reuse works, dated pricing is not implemented. Preserve your work with the normal backup route.
steps.why: Separate observation from an unbuilt feature.
steps.expected: Another reader can verify the specific records.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not claim tariff or accounting verification from the name text.
steps.before: Same service code and original durations.

criteria: Use Designer properties and distinguish metadata from values.
One service code, two request numbers and older data intact.
Type/length and older-item checks specified; names are not tariff history.
Actual infobase/version, own synthetic codes and numbers, before/after field observations.
Saved source and outcome; any missing or untested behavior explicitly recorded.
Use the second worked case only in an own copy or unsaved draft. Preserve the accepted record and explain the discrepancy.
